title: ADIndex: Layer-Adaptive Sparse Attention Indexing via Group-Level Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.12956v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) reduces the computational cost of attention through token-level selection. However, its indexer still scores the entire causal prefix for each query, making indexing a dominant source of latency in long-context inference. Notably, the indexer alone can account for more than 50% of total prefill GPU time at long context lengths. To address this bottleneck, we propose ADIndex, an Adaptive and Distillation-driven Indexing method for token-level sparse attention. translated_title: ADIndex：基于组级蒸馏的层级自适应稀疏注意力索引
translated_abstract: DeepSeek稀疏注意力（DSA）通过token级选择降低了注意力的计算成本。然而，其索引器仍需为每个查询对整个因果前缀进行评分，使索引成为长上下文推理中延迟的主要来源。值得注意的是，在长上下文长度下，仅索引器一项就可能占总预填充GPU时间的50%以上。为解决这一瓶颈，我们提出了ADIndex，一种面向token级稀疏注意力的自适应、蒸馏驱动的索引方法。ADIndex集成了三个关键组件：(i) 逐层校准策略，可自适应地适应跨查询检索重叠，其动机源自我们观察到的显著的层间异质性；(ii) 组级蒸馏方案，利用这种异质性高效训练自适应的逐层组索引器，从单个查询中捕捉关键的检索信号；(iii) 低延迟推理策略，用于降低……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ADIndex通过逐层校准与组级蒸馏训练层级自适应的稀疏注意力索引器，并辅以低延迟推理策略，大幅降低长上下文推理中索引环节的延迟开销。
en_tdlr: ADIndex introduces layer-wise calibration and group-level distillation to train adaptive layer-wise sparse attention indexers, coupled with a low-latency inference strategy to significantly reduce indexing latency in long-context inference.
